Production pixel art RPG monster spritesheet, transparent alpha background. EXACT GRID 8 columns by 5 rows = 40 full body sprites, all cells equal 192x204 pixels on approximately 1536x1020 canvas. Each sprite centered with identical foot baseline within its cell and empty padding between sprites. No text, no labels, no floor, no shadows outside character, no extra standalone objects. Rows: facing south/front, southeast three-quarter front, east/right profile, northeast three-quarter back, north/back. Columns: idle1, idle2 breathing, walk left foot contact, walk passing, walk right foot contact, walk passing alternate, attack action, hurt recoil. Clear visible arms and legs matching each direction and pose. Native detailed crisp pixel art, hard edges, limited palette, dark outlines, about 100x140 actual drawn pixels per cell; cute squat imposing RPG enemy 1.6 times hero height, 3-head proportions. Uniform actual scale across ALL 40 poses. ANCIENT SUNKEN SANCTUARY MONSTER family: weathered pale gray-brown carved stone, olive moss clusters, oxidized bronze details, luminous restrained turquoise rune slit eyes. No fire, no snow, no skeleton anatomy. Melee statue soldier: broad cracked stone torso, short thick articulated legs, broken crown-like stone head with glowing turquoise single visor, asymmetric mossy shoulder slabs, right forearm ends in heavy chisel-shaped stone blade, left is bare stone fist. Attack column lunges and swings chisel arm across body. Distinct upright silhouette, no shield and no staff.
